title: SeatAssignment
description: Where one guest sits (issue #46): at most one table per guest, so it is keyed by the guest — groupedKey(wedding_id, guest_id). Removed with the guest (the guest list's hook) or with the table.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

guest_id.description: A guest (wedding_guest) of the same wedding.

table_id.description: A table of the same wedding.

seated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the guest was seated there, from the injected clock.
